## Code Review Findings Summary

### Standards Axis
- **Conventions & Architecture**: Conforms to `AGENTS.md` and codebase design principles. All code, comments, and commit messages written in English.
- **Repository Verification**:
  - `npm run type-check`: 0 errors.
  - `npm test`: 24 test suites, 264 tests passed.
  - `npm run test:evals`: 3 test suites, 26 tests passed.
  - `npm run build`: Clean ESM build (`dist/index.js`).
- **Smell Baseline**: 0 hard violations. 1 minor judgement call on async title resolution boilerplate in `runner.ts`, non-blocking.

### Spec Axis (PR #107)
- **Status**: 100% compliant with specifications.
  - Title cleaning & truncation (`cleanTargetTitle`) correctly strips conventional commit prefixes (`feat(runner): `, `fix: `, `chore(deps)!: `) and trailing issue references (`(#96)`), truncating to ~28 characters on word boundaries.
  - Label formatting (`formatTargetLabel`) properly constructs `<BaseTarget> (<CleanTitle>)`, cleanly replaces existing parenthesized titles, and falls back gracefully to base label if missing.
  - Non-blocking asynchronous title resolution (`fetchTargetTitleAsync`) uses strict 3000ms timeout for PR and Issue queries without blocking the event loop.
  - Option support (`title?: string` in `RunLocalRoutineOptions`) and card propagation (`renderSummaryCard` / `renderErrorCard`).
  - Unit tests added in `tests/terminal-card.test.ts` and `tests/runner.test.ts`.
  - `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`.

### Security Pass
- Zero hardcoded credentials or secrets.
- Child process execution (`fetchTargetTitleAsync`) uses `execFileAsync` (avoiding shell execution) with numeric regex extraction (`\d+`), preventing command injection risks.
- Graceful error trapping and strict timeout preventing hanging processes.
